text: Shit! I thought I had two more days. Damn it!
Jason pick up it's me. Jason come on I need you. I know you're there.
What the fuck!
Madison! Is that you honey, wait I can explain.

Hello. Hey Madison how are you. Oh no what's wrong. That bastard. Listen baby it's really not a good time. You need how much. Alright I got you. Pick you up? When? Alright I'll be there. Alright baby, have a good flight.
Pack up your shit Jetta. I'll be back for you in a couple of hours after the paper work clears.
I'll be here.
Heard they letting you out bitch. I got a going away gift for your ass.
I'm finished here
Mr. Mann please don't do it
Hello. How are you Dr. Mitchell. What happened now. Ah huh. Ah huh.

He did what. Are you shitting me? Ah huh. He's alive? Well listen Dr. Mitchell his sister is flying in tonight and I know she'll want to see him. I see. Is there any chance he can be released to her. With medication. I see. Alright then Dr. Mitchell thank you.
Jetta it's good to see you.
You too Des. Thanks for picking me up.
Don't mention it. Let's get the hell out of here. I hate prisons.
Yeah. Me too.
Your a free woman Jetta

I may be out of prison but I'm not free. A free person can do whatever they want to. I want to hold my son and I can't. I want to go home and be held by my husband and I can't. I don't even have a home to go home to.
We're not to far away. I can always take you back.
fuck you Des. What's with the suit?
Oh I was at a funeral earlier.
Earlier when?
Around the time you called
Oh my God Des I'm so sorry. Why did you answer the phone.
The caller I.D. said unavailable and I thought it was a call I was expecting. I had to take it.
Who died.
Not died. Killed. My baby brother.
Pop! Oh no. What happened Des
Pop was involved with some crazy shit. Damn cops don't know the whole story. I got an investigator looking into it for me. When I find out who killed my brother I'm going to kill the muthafucka.
Stop playing Des. I don't want to have to visit you in jail.
I'm serious. The mutha fucka is dead. You won't be visiting me in jail because I don't plan on getting caught.
I'll help you
What the fuck are they smoking in prison these days. You must be kidding. You just got out
I thought you didn't plan on getting caught?
Don't be a wise ass.

I'm not. I'm serious. Besides I'm not talking about helping you kill him. I'm talking about helping you. Get control over yourself Des. You see where revenge got me. Five years. Even if you don't get caught that kind of shit catches up to you.
Don't give me that shit Jetta. Put that energy into finding your son.
Please don't bring that up Des. I can't deal with that.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean it that way. All I'm saying is no matter where he's at your still his mother.
I said I don't want to talk about Marlon god damn it Des. It's over! He's gone. I made my choice.
I didn't touch him. I swear it. I didn't touch him. He's confused.
Now you know fear. You're an animal! You'll never put your hands on another innocent child.
I'm not lying. Just put the gun down
Shut the fuck up. I don't want to hear your lies.
We're are we?
We're at the airport. We're picking up Madison.
Des I'm sorry I yelled at you.
Don't sweat it baby. Do me a favor
What is it.
Shut up and listen for one minute.

You're being a selfish bitch. A boy needs his mother. I won't let you sit here and give up on being a part of his life. You're out of prison now. You should have left that woe is me bullshit there. You ain't the first mother to serve time and you damn sure won't be the last. You said you want to help me. Help me by finding that boy and letting him know that you're there for him.
You're right Des I am being selfish.
That's for calling me a bitch.
You're still driving that old Cadillac Des. It's the Twenty first century. Why don't you get a new car.
Why don't you stop borrowing money from me so I can actually afford a new car Madi. Damn. I forgot how fuckin annoying you are. I still love you. You just annoy the hell out of me.
I can't believe how muscular you've gotten Jetta. How did you do that. Yoga?
Prison.
Oh. I hope it was someone I hate?
Oh hell no. You're not sitting in the front with me.
Oh Des stop playing
I'm not playing. Scoot your ass to the back.
So then I hit him with the paint can and knocked his sorry ass out. That little hussy of his just sat there.
So I take it the engagement is off.
That's not funny Desmond. I really loved him.
I'm sorry Madi. How's the painting going.
That's what brings me here.. I was working on my best piece yet when I got evicted from my studio
You got evicted, what happened?
What happened is Madi doesn't believe in paying her own bills. When are you going to get a real job
Stop it Des. She's a starving artist
Artist maybe, starving definitely not. You could stand to lose a few pounds Madi.
Go to hell Des. Now I know why I left New York.
Because of me?
You and that crazy ass brother of mine. Speaking of Fifth where is he.
What do mean where is he? You know damn well he's in the hospital. When's the last time you called the hospital Madi?
That's what he has you for Des. I'm not going to raise my blood pressure over Fifth anymore. If he wants to kill himself he's not going to take me with him.
Don't tell me Fifth's still suicidal.
He's just a little confused. I'm talking some since into him.
Four Ph.D. psychologists can't talk since to him but you can Des.
Damn right.
Well you deserve each other. I told you before and I'll tell you again, it doesn't take ten years to commit suicide. My brother just wants attention.
As usual Madi you don't know what the hell your talking about. I came this close to losing my best friend today.
How is he doctor?
He's suicidal. Last week we let him in the garden to get some fresh air.

The orderly turned his back for a second and Mr. Mann tried to hang himself from a tree with his pants. One minute longer and he would have affixciated We have him under twenty four hour surveillance in a soft room now.
Can I go in the room? I need to speak to him about matters of a very confidential nature.
Sure but he will have to remain restrained. Do you have any foreign objects on you.
Well I have this heirloom pen, and my eye glasses . That's it.
Is that it.
Yes I believe so.
Why's he dancing like that?
Because he's crazy.
Hey Blaine. How's it hanging?
It's hanging well, thank you very much.
What brings you here today Blaine. Hey nice suit.

Thank you. I'm here to talk business Fifth. I really think you should reconsider my offer. Dr. Mitchell told me about the incident in the garden. Really Fifth if you insist on killing yourself at least think about the hundreds of hard working people the firm employs.
You mean like you Blaine. What's wrong Blaine six cars and the mansion in Bronxville not enough for you.

It's not about me Fifth. You know that. These are tough times. The firm can't afford to pay out twenty million dollars on an insurance premium if you die. Please reconsider our settlement offer to breach the contract.

You're right Blaine. What was I thinking. I owe it to the employees. I don't want to see them out of work. It's the med's Blaine. They just keep drugging me up. It's got my head all smoky. I can't think straight half of the time.
Maybe I can talk to Dr. Mitchell.
No! She's the leader. She's had it in for me since day one. I turned down her advances and before I knew it she had me more doped up than Robert Downey. Fuck!
What is it.
My balls itch. Hey Blaine I don't suppose I could impose on you.
Certainly not.
Fifth about the insurance.
Can't think about that right now Blaine. You ever have itchy balls and couldn't scratch them. Shit! Drives me crazy.
Perhaps I could free one hand. Then it's back to business.
Of course.
Ooohh! That's it. Ooohh that's good.
Orderly come quick.
I think he swallowed his tongue or something.
Holy shit!
Those investigators have stopped Fifth at least a dozen times. They're the best.
But Des honey. What makes you think that you can talk Fifth out of killing himself.
I can't. If I can help keep him alive until he wakes the fuck up then he'll cut the crazy shit out. At least I hope so
I know you don't want to see your friend die Des but

But what Madi. And he's not just my friend. He's your fucking brother. Hell I remember you being a lot more concerned before he gave away all his money. It seems like you always find yourself back here when dead fucking broke.

Fuck you Des. That's not fair. You know I love my brother. You think I want to see him dead. I've going through this shit for years. Since he first tried at fifteen. I was there. You weren't. It's like a sick movie that just keeps dragging on. I'm tired Des. That doesn't mean I don't love my brother.
Good. You're get a chance to prove it.
Prove it how.
Only you can sign him out. I spoke to Dr. Mitchell earlier and she and I agree that seeing you might help him.
What do you mean sign him out.
She'll sign him over to your care. You'll be responsible. Don't worry. The investigators will be on him like white on rice. It'll be fine
I'm sorry visiting hours are over.
Listen eagle eye we're hear to pick up a discharged patient. Fifth Mann
Fifth Mann? I need the entire name The guard picks up a list and looks at it.

Fuck me! That is the real name. And I thought Black people had some crazy names. It says here that he can only be released into the custody of Madison Mann. Oh I get it. Fifth and Madison, that's cute.
That's me. I'm Madison Mann
I'll need to see some ID.
Oh shit the gang's all here. It's the reunion of the broken hearts club.
This is a surprise Madi. You came to New York to see me.
That and other things Fifth. I'm telling you right now you're not going to try no crazy shit with me.
I got it Madi. Nothing crazy.
It's good to see you.
Hey Superman.
Des the mon'. What it is Bro. I'm sorry about Pop. Dr. Mitchell told me. How you doing?
I been better.
What happened to Pop?
Pop was shot and killed last week Madi. His funeral was this morning.
Desmond why didn't you say something. Please don't tell me I called you at the funeral.
I didn't say anything because you didn't ask. Forget about it
Jetta look at you. Been working out huh.
A little something.
Hey they'll be none of that in here. This is a hospital.
You're not the boss of me. Come on club. Let's get the hell out of here. This place is for crazy people.
Hey can I drive?
There's your answer
I don't know about the rest of you but I could kill for a cheese burger.
I mean I could really go for a good cheese burger. I haven't had a decent meal in five years.
Really where you been Jet?
I was in jail Fifth.
Get the fuck out! You didn't tell me Des.
Yes I did mutha fucka. Those meds' are scrambling your brain. Where do you live?
Wait a minute. I know where I live. Oh shit I can't remember.
I'm going to have a talk with that doctor of yours tomorrow.
So if you were in jail then where is Marlon?
Do me a favor Fifth.
Shut up?
You're a mind reader.

It feels funny to be on the outside. Five fucking years is a along time. Fuck it. It was worth it to have one less monster in the world. I'd do it again if I had to. My only regret is I lost my family. I miss my baby. Five years with seeing your child is torture. I'm sorry guys

That looks good. I should have ordered that. I'm starving. Where the hell is my food. I haven't eaten in two days. I never wanted to do the starving artist literally. You're right Des. I'm broke, I'm homeless. My work sucks, my fucking life stinks.
Finally
So I guess we're all crashing at your place tonight Des.
Over my dead body Madi. I've got the keys to Fifth's loft in my pocket. You and superman are going home. Jetta your welcome to crash with me if you want.
Don't look at me.
I had to borrow plane-fare.
What I didn't give away you took. I'm running on empty.
Just like old times. A bunch of broke muthafuckas.
Good night guys. Thank you Des. I'll call you tomorrow.
I'm to tired for this shit
This isn't a spot. What are you doing
I've been driving all fucking day. I'm tired as fuck. I'll move it in the morning.
Bubble? Bubble what the hell are you doing on my stoop at two in the morning.
I'm waiting for you son.
Listen I'm too tired for this bullshit. Get your fake thug ass off my stoop. And take those hip hop pirates with you.
We got business to discuss. You know how we do. Pop had an outstanding debt and as his nearest to kin you gotta cover.
I just buried my brother today and you come around here showing your nuts.
Business is business.
Oh! It's like that?
It's like that
Five G's Des. Bizness' is Bizness'
You think I got that kinda cash laying around.
For your homegirls' sake I hope you do. I won't kill you cause I want my doe. You want her to live you better go in there and come back out with five grand.
I see where you coming from. Alright I'll be right back.
Don't worry shorty.
Thanks
Don't mention it. What was that all about.
Some kid Pop scrambled with. Stupid young muthafucka. This new millennium hip hop shit has these punks thinking they like it raw.
How about some hard core
I don't know about you but I'm through. I'm about to pass out. I gotta get some sleep.
I wanted to talk to you.
We can talk in the morning. You can have the bed tonight. After that it's the couch.
I think I'm going to take a bath before I get in bed.
Knock yourself out
Morning brother dear.
Morning sis. How did you sleep.
I slept great. There's something about New York nights that make me sleep like a baby. How did you sleep.
I didn't. I sat up on the roof and waited for the sun
That's beautiful. Stay off the roof!
Fifth. What's this?
I know, I know. I'm sorry Madi I know you don't want to see me hurt.
That's not even it Fifth. How can you hurt yourself like that. What goes through your mind when your slicing your arteries open.
The ends justify the means. I know I don't belong here so I do what I need to do to end it.
But you're still here.
I know. Crazy isn't it. I've been close a couple of times.
Shut up. I don't want to hear it. What would mom say Fifth. If she were still alive you would have killed her by now.
Madi you can't live life for someone else. When I was fifteen I made the decision to end it all. You and Mom interfered and I've been trying ever since. Life simply holds no meaning to me Madi
I don't understand. You're young, women fall all over themselves for you, you were filthy rich and your my brother. You have it all.
That's it all to you Madison. If that's it all then why don't you want that.
Because that's not what I want.

So what makes you think that it's what I want. I made all that money for Mom. I wanted her to have her dream and to live the life she always envied. She had her penthouse, she had her private showings at Tiffany's. None of that shit means anything to me.
What's so bad about your life
I'm just not feeling it.
That's stupid
That's your opinion Madison. I've never criticized the way you live. The jerks you chose to throw your heart at.
There's a difference. I'm not trying to kill myself.
A minor difference.
Here we go
What.
There's a leak under the tub. Every time you flush the toilet or let water out of the tub it leaks downstairs.
Why don't you get it fixed
I've been meaning to but my hands were tied.
You asshole.Why don't you get that pipe fixed. You're fucking up my prints.
blow it out your ear. You old hag.
Is she an old hag?
Hell if I know. I've never met her.
What do you mean you've never met her. How long has she been living here.
She moved in around the same time as me. I'm not exactly the socializing type Madi. I spend most of my time in a padded room. Besides, she sounds like a hag.
You need to go talk to her
Ahh phooey.
Let's make breakfast
The fridge is empty. On top of that they turned off my gas. They didn't want me blowing myself up
Alright I guest well be going out for breakfast. You got any money
OK see here's the part I don't understand. Where the hell is all of your money.
I gave it away. Hell you can't take it with you. I gave most of it to the poor. I still have a few stocks but I leave those to charity in my will.
Everything goes to charity
Pretty much. I left this loft to Des. He's the one that takes care of it when I'm in the hospital.
Well now that you're alive wouldn't it have been nice to have a dime to your name.

Well that's what friends are for. Des took a hundred grand from me a couple years ago. If I find myself alive and broke he gives me enough money to eat. He's really suspicious though so he makes me bring back receipts for everything. He thinks I might try to buy a gun and blow my head off.
Have you tried that?
Believe it or not there's certain things I won't do. I don't want to drown, I don't like car crashes and I won't stab myself in the gut you know like the samurai do.
I still don't believe that your serious.
You've never thought I was serious. When I was 15 I saw my whole life ahead of me. It all seemed like one big joke. I can't live in a world like this.

There's suffering in the world Fifth. But it's still a beautiful place. You're trying to take the easy way out. All these people your heart is bleeding for, they live, they struggle and sometimes they triumph. You have a sister, you have a best friend. You have a reason to live.
I can't live for you Madi. I can't live for Des. I have to live for me. I just don't see it. I just don't see the purpose.

Mom never told you how Dad died Fifth. She never told you that he was sick. You were to young. His mind Fifth. It was all fucked up. The sad part is you sound a lot like him. Stop thinking you're so fucking smart. Your 28 years old damn it. You don't know every fucking thing.
What's up. What's that? Alright. Shit I had a long night too you don't hear me complaining to you. Good. I knew you would come through. Knick's. Alright gimme 15 minutes. I'll be there.
Wow.
What?
Nothing. It's been along time. I forgot how beautiful you look in the morning.
It's too early for your bullshit Des
I'm serious. Most people look like shit in the morning. Not you. It's the truth
You want some coffee?
I gotta run. Got a meeting in ten minutes.
I thought we were going to talk.
They'll be time later on. What you gonna do today.
I need to look for a job.
Good luck. There's some cash in the coffee can. I'll see you later
Jonesy good morning. Jonesy do me a favor. I think some kids were playing on my stoop. Can you spray it down for me.
Fifth are you dressed.
Yeah almost
What's almost. All you wear are T-shirts.
I'm trying to find the right shoes.
Put on anything and let's go
Whatever.
What? Where are we going anyway
The official sport of New York. Shopping
I'm always down to cop more T-shirts but your forgetting one thing
And what's that Fifth?
We're both broke.
I'm broke. Your loaded. What about your credit cards?
Gone.
Don't you have store accounts?
All closed.
Central park it is
You know her.
No. I've never seen her before.
It's always good to know your neighbors brother dear.
Why?
They can sign for packages, lend you sugar and spot you condoms in the middle of the night.
Oh.
We do tattoos by appointment only. You got an appointment.
I don't want a tattoo
Then what the hell are you doing in here
Nacho what the fuck is the matter with you. Don't you see this is a fuckin lady your talking to. Where the fuck are your manners. God damn! I'm sorry mam how can I help you.
I'm looking for work.
You an artist?
This is my portfolio.
How we know she did that shit. She could be lying.
You got a big fucking mouth kid. Obviously some chic burned you real bad. I'm not her so I suggest you calm your ass down.
What the fuck did you say to me bitch?
Nacho! I think you better...
Nah fuck that Tony I got this. No bitch mouths off to me.
What the fuck are you going to do about it.
What!
Nacho I think you should listen
Fuck that. I'm going to teach this bitch some respect. She got lucky
You young stupid fuck. I tried to tell you. That work on her. It's prison style.
I'm sorry about this
Nothing to be sorry about. I love to kick white boy ass. You better think twice before you call me a bitch again.
Hey! You really do all that work yourself?
What do you know about prison tattoos?
I know they hurt like hell.
Damn straight. Yeah I did them
I could use some more help around here. Can you work the gun?
Yeah I can do it.
If you hire that dyke Tony I'm quitting.
It's been good working with you kid
Fuck you. I'm out of here
Hey Nacho!
I'll smell you later.
It's been over a week Marcos and you're telling me you got nothing.
Des listen to me. Listen to my words. There's no leads. Your brother was dealing drugs. He could have been shot by a crackhead for all I know. It's gonna take some time.
Time!
Yes time. What's your rush anyway. I find him, you kill him. Bam! That's it! Game over.
That was my brother. This is not a fucking game to me. While we're sitting here wasting time my brother's murderer could be in Cuba by now.
Don't talk about Cubans Des. What you trying to say about Cubans. How come the killer has to run to Cuba
Marcos calm down. It was just an example.
Well don't bring Cuba into this shit. Why couldn't you say Columbia or Mexico. You think Cuba has something to do with drugs
Fine! Damn it. Did you follow the lead I gave you.
No
What do you mean no. That's a legit lead.

Des listen. Between me and you I can't follow that lead. That's some hot shit and I don't mean good. I don't want to know anything about that you got me. If the lead turns out to be your guy, which I don't think it is then you're fucked because he's to connected to be touched.
We'll see
Well leave me out of it
How's superman.
Fifth? He's cool. With his sister in town I think he'll chill out for a minute.
Good fuckin luck. I've seen some crazy shit in my life time and he's done ninety percent of it. I'll tell you Des when hejumped of that fuckin roof I damn near pissed on myself.
No shit
No shit. I knew the firemen were coming but I didn't think they'd be ready. That mutha fucker is bonafide crazy. I feel bad for you Des.
Why's that.
If a man wants to die that bad, he's going to die. I hope you can handle it when it happens
It ain't happened yet.
Well I pray it won't my friend. He's such a bright kid I don't understand it. He's fucking nuts.

Everybody's nuts. You ever pick a paper. Kids getting killed, stupid wars over oil, people starving in other countries while Americans sit on their fat asses. It's not exactly a perfect fucking world.
Nobody said it was perfect. That's no reason to off yourself.
Everybody's got to have something to live for. Fifth hasn't found it yet. Hell I know where he's coming from. I've been there.
So why not let him go?

I like him. Besides I know what he doesn't. The good ones die young. Like my
fucking brother?
So your saying he was a good drug dealer.

The ends can justify the means. I'm not going to get into a debate with you over career opportunities for young black men. I'm just saying the kid had a good heart. He cared about people. So does Fifth. We need more people like that in this world.
I agree Des. Listen I'll do what I can.
I appreciate that.
I gotta run. Well get up later.
Get up Des. Get your ass up. I said I wouldn't do this shit to myself anymore.
What's up. How long you been there?
I just walked in.
How was the job search
I found something. It's not much but it's a job
Let me guess. Bouncer
Funny.
Cop
I wish. I'm shooting ink into trashers' down in hell's kitchen
That was my next guess. That sounds like a fulfilling career.
Shut up. It's not like ex-cons have a lot of career choices.
Where are you going.
I gotta take a piss. Is that cool with you?
You can keep talking.
I'll wait, I hate yelling.
You could close the door you know
I got no shame. Besides I'm proud of my stream.
I kill your mother?
What?
You're eying me like I killed your mother.
My mother would kick your ass.
Maybe. I don't know if she could handle the left hook.
I'm gonna tell her you said that.
Tell her. Ain't nobody scared of her. I'm just kidding don't tell her that shit. I don't need her mad at me.
You speak to her?
About once a month. I look in on her from time to time. You know, make sure she has what she needs.
I don't get it Des. Every woman out there is looking for a man like you and you're sitting here.
If there was anything out there for me I would have found it by now. Besides things have changed. I'm not the man I use to be.
I disagree
You don't know.
Well I'm just saying.
What are you just saying Jetta. Spit it out I'm not stupid. I see the way you look at me. You got something on your mind say it.
I just wanted to know
You just wanted to know what I'm dealing with. You want to know what's up with me. I don't know what to tell you Jetta. I got tired of standing out in the rain waiting for a bus that ain't coming.
So what did you do
I stole a car.
Des I'm not trying to
Trying to what

Would let me finish a god damned sentence. I'm not trying to open old wounds Des. You stood by me through everything. You check in on my mother. your mother. not to mention Fifth. I just think you deserve to be happy that's all
Happiness is like good sex. We can't all have it. I thought I could once
What good sex?
Nah happiness.
I sat down one night with an old friend. Jack D, and thought about how deep of a concept a broken heart is.
Broken things can be fixed.
Not all things. Besides who says everything has to be fixes.
You got a point. I still think you'll find happiness in your life.
I've done to much Jetta. I'm one of those sinners our mothers pray for on Sundays.
Do you remember Sunday school
Jetta if I want a bible sermon I'll
Shut up. Remember King David. You always loved the stories about King David
Yeah. He was the man. He killed Goliath then started kicking ass all over the promise land.
You remember how when it was time to build the temple he couldn't because he had done to much. Even though it was in the name of God.
Yeah I remember. Solomon built the temple because David was a sinner.
Even the greatest of men fall Des. There's still hope for you. You have to make a choice. Turn your life around now if you want to be happy.
I hear you. I'll try but I think it's too late. All I ever wanted was a family. I fell in love with a girl.
Des I'm ...
Don't say it. I didn't want to hear it then and I don't want to hear it now. I never blamed you. I'm just drunk and talking out my ass.
Who is it?
It's me
Hey Jetta. What's wrong with you. Who died now.
Shut the hell up with all that noise Madi.
What the hell is wrong with you. You out of booze. Don't worry we'll get you some more. Come on lets go out. My brother and I have been doing up the city.
You mean hanging out in the park begging for change with your broke ass.
Des I swear one of these days.
What, bang, zoom.
No! I'm gonna hit you in the nuts. Come on. You can make it up to me with a drink.
I'll buy you a drink but I ain't going no where for a little while.
Why?
I ain't exactly in driving condition.
So what. Fifth has a license.
For one he ain't driving my car.
And two, have you ever had the misfortune to be in a car that you brother was driving.
Mutha fucker what the hell are you doing. Slow the hell down.
(Youthful Giggle)
This shit ain't funny Fifth. Slow down.
Fifth! I thought you hate car crashes. Fifth what the fuck are you doing.
Oh shit. You son of a bitch. You're not taking me with you
God damn boy are you okay. What the hell kind of driving was that.
That's what it's like when Fifth drives.
Let's take a taxi.
I'm not going anywhere until I piss out these toxins. What's your rush. Ain't nothing new happening in this city.
I got numbers to take and hearts to break.
And ass to shake
Well it's ten o'clock. You can shake your ass in a couple of hours.
That's cool
You don't know nothing about this
Yeah whatever. None of that fancy riffling' will help your ass win a game.
You hear this Madi. See how short people's memories are.
Um hum.
I suppose you don't remember how me and my partner here took your shirt the last time we played cards.
You're right. I don't remember no shit like that.
If we send him to Boston how we gonna get to the party?
These chics are talking shit about sending somebody to Boston.
Wisk huh. I'm down.
You get all those in jail.
Yup.
Did they
Hurt like hell? Yup
Damn. I thought about getting a tattoo.
Let me guess. A butterfly oh no a Celtic cross
No smart ass. A broken heart
Figures
You never thought about getting a tattoo Des. You seem like a tattoo kind of guy.
Fuck tattoos. I got scars
A scar kicks a tattoos ass any day.
Your bid Fifth
I pass
I pass too.
What the hell is going on here. Gimme a four low.
I'll take a four no.
You can't look at the kitty before you call uptown or down.
I don't have to call
Yes you do
